name: extEquivCohomologyClass_symm_add
statement: CohomologyClass ((singleFunctor C 0).obj X) R.cochainComplex n) : R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm (x + y) = R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm x + R.extEquivCohomologyClass.symm y

name: mk₀_comp_extMk
statement: ℕ} (f : X ⟶ R.cocomplex.X n) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 = m) (hf : f ≫ R.cocomplex.d n m = 0) {X' : C} (g : X' ⟶ X) : (Ext.mk₀ g).comp (R.extMk f m hm hf) (zero_add _) = R.extMk (g ≫ f) m hm (by simp [hf])

name: extMk_comp_mk₀
statement: ℕ} (f : X ⟶ R.cocomplex.X n) (m : ℕ) (hm : n + 1 = m) (hf : f ≫ R.cocomplex.d n m = 0) {Y' : C} {R' : InjectiveResolution Y'} {g : Y ⟶ Y'} (φ : Hom R R' g) : (R.extMk f m hm hf).comp (Ext.mk₀ g) (add_zero _) = R'.extMk (f ≫ φ.hom.f n) m hm (by simp [reassoc_of% hf])
